title: Removed Card Refund Share on Northgate Business Memberships
content:
On Northgate Memberships business memberships, the refund for a removed business add-on card is worked from the removed card refund share. The removed card refund share depends on how long after the fee charge the card was removed and on whether the card was first issued before the current membership year began.

## The tier's full refund window

| Tier | Full refund window (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Northgate Student Club Membership | 30 |
| Northgate Heroes Club Membership | 90 |
| Northgate Club Membership | 90 |
| Northgate Business Membership | 60 |
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | 90 |
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | 60 |

## Rule

When the card was removed more than 30 days and no more than the tier's full refund window of days after its add-on fee was charged and was first issued before the current membership year began, the removed card refund share is the add-on fee multiplied by the whole months from the removal date to the expiry date and divided by twelve, rounded to the cent. When the card was removed more than the tier's full refund window of days and no more than 120 days after its add-on fee was charged and was first issued before the current membership year began, the removed card refund share is half the add-on fee, rounded to the cent. Any other removal takes as its share the full add-on fee when the card is removed no more than the tier's full refund window of days after its add-on fee was charged, and nothing when it is removed later.

**Terms.** Days are calendar days from the date the add-on fee was charged to the removal date. A card was first issued before the current membership year began when its issue date is earlier than the first day of the current membership year. Whole months from the removal date to the expiry date count a month only when the expiry date's day of the month has reached the removal date's day of the month.

## Decision table (tier window of 60 days)

| Days from the fee charge to the removal | Card first issued before the current year | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | either | full add-on fee |
| 31 to 60 | Yes | add-on fee multiplied by whole months to expiry, divided by twelve |
| 31 to 60 | No | full add-on fee |
| 61 to 120 | Yes | half the add-on fee |
| 61 to 120 | No | nothing |
| more than 120 | either | nothing |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; Business Plus, year 1 January to 31 December 2027, add-on fee 65.00 charged at renewal on 1 January 2027)

| Card first issued | Removed | Days | Whole months to expiry | Share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 June 2025 | 15 February 2027 | 45 | 10 | 65.00 multiplied by 10, divided by twelve: 54.17 |
| 10 June 2025 | 15 March 2027 | 73 | — | half of 65.00: 32.50 |
| 10 June 2025 | 15 May 2027 | 134 | — | nothing |
| 5 February 2027 (fee charged that day) | 20 March 2027 | 43 | — | full fee: 65.00 |
